market.question: Will the highest temperature in Wuhan be 25°C on May 1?

assessment.reasoning: Wuhan May 1 forecast shows high ~19-20°C from web sources. Question asks if HIGH = 25°C exactly (typically a 1°C bin). Forecast points to 19-20°C, not 25°C. Probability of an exact 25°C high is low given current forecast.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast may shift; resolution rule of equality (1°C bin) is narrow.
